backers.headline: Back the next drop
backers.copy: Backing pays for the next run of merch and music. You get the pieces you back, a numbered spot on the backer wall, and a ledger of everything you have put in and received. This is support and a pre-order, not an investment: there is no financial return and no promised resale value.
